newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Chidambaram introduces new Companies Act.
newsitem.headline: India's Chidambaram introduces new Companies Act.

text.p: Indian Finance Minister P. Chidambaram on Thursday introduced a bill in parliament to amend a 40-year old Companies Act, the Press Trust of India said (PTI).

The new bill incorporates a strong code of corporate governance, a restoration of corporate democracy, and the protection of the rights of investors, depositors, employees, creditors and other participants, PTI said.

The news agency said the bill seeks to achieve the objectives of liberalisation, deregulation, simplification, effective enforcement of laws, and flexibility to meet changing economic and corporate scenarios.
The bill was promised by Chidambaram in his 1996/97 (April-March) budget speech on February 28.
